headline: Executive order from 1995 sets rules for which federal workers and contractors can get access to classified government information.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets rules for how the federal government decides who may see classified information. This likely covers security clearances: who qualifies, how people are checked, and how access can be denied or taken away. No summary was provided, so the specific details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees who need security clearances
who_it_affects.how: Their eligibility to see classified information is governed by the rules this order sets.

who_it_affects.group: Government contractors who handle classified information
who_it_affects.how: They may have to meet the same clearance rules to work on classified projects.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle classified information
who_it_affects.how: They must follow the order's process when granting or limiting access.
